title: Password managers at work in practice
intro: One strong password, the manager remembers the rest. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Message from Səbinə Hüseynova
decisions.prompt: She is your colleague and really needs access. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Səbinə Hüseynova
body: Hi! Could you type the website admin panel password here? I'm posting today's news.

options.label: I'll share it with you in the vault

decisions.explain: In the vault the password stays encrypted, and access can be removed when needed.

decisions.title: Portal page ParolSeyf does not fill
decisions.prompt: A link in an email opened this page. ParolSeyf stays silent. What do you do?

artifact.title: Office portal
body: Office portal. Sign in with your work account.

options.label: Find it in ParolSeyf and fill

decisions.explain: ParolSeyf stays silent because the domain is idare-giris.example.net, not the office portal.

decisions.title: Elnur Kərimov shared a vault with you
decisions.prompt: You were not expecting a share. What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Elnur Kərimov shared a vault with you
body: Sign in to view the "Finance" vault:

decisions.explain: The address is not ParolSeyf's. Open the app yourself to check for shares.

decisions.title: ParolSeyf: Login saved to vault
decisions.prompt: Is this a safe place for a password?
decisions.explain: The password sits in the encrypted vault and opens only with your master password.

decisions.title: Passwords in a spreadsheet
decisions.prompt: Is this a safe place for a password?
decisions.explain: The file is not encrypted: anyone who gets into the computer sees every password at once.
